scripts.dev: concurrently -n public,hub,intake -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @bielos/public-site" "npm run dev --workspace @bielos/hub" "npm run dev --workspace @bielos/intake"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bielos/public-site && npm run build --workspace @bielos/hub
scripts.test:core: npm run test:core:unit && npm run test:core:db
scripts.test:core:unit: tsx --test scripts/core-test-database-safety.test.mjs packages/database/src/identity-access.test.ts packages/auth/src/email.test.ts packages/auth/src/security.test.ts packages/auth/src/administration.test.ts apps/intake/src/handler.test.ts packages/auth/src/cloudflare-access.test.ts packages/auth/src/command-output.test.ts packages/auth/src/rate-limit-config.test.ts packages/auth/src/session-cookie.test.ts apps/hub/src/proxy.test.ts apps/hub/src/lib/hub-redirect.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/api/logout/route.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/projects/validation.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/projects/access-policy.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/projects/detail-policy.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/security/session-policy.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/security/audit-view.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/operations.test.ts apps/hub/src/app/core/modules/service.test.ts
scripts.status:ports: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.cloudflare.yml ps public-site hub
scripts.audit:recent: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.cloudflare.yml exec -T hub npm run audit:recent --workspace @bielos/auth
scripts.audit:cleanup: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml -f infra/docker-compose.cloudflare.yml exec -T hub npm run audit:cleanup --workspace @bielos/auth
